comment: Module registry (v0.4). Coarse-grained ON PURPOSE: 7 modules, not 18 - over-modularization is a documented anti-pattern (audit 2026-07-14 c.1). Every skill dir / agent file of the socle must be claimed by exactly one module (resolve-modules.ps1 -Validate enforces it). 'paths' are whole subtrees always vendored with the module.

modules.description: Governance socle + immune system (v1.1 lesson: a lab without capitalization/closure/memory-consolidation is an empty shell). Never excludable.
Product framing workflow: discovery -> PRD -> locked architecture -> compiled build prompt, with blocking PRD-coverage review (R001).
Build-session review layer: code review (single + parallel mass review) and purpose-built worker forging.
Advanced capitalization beyond the core loop: BDR/eval promotions, register dedup, memory-age audits, cross-lab traffic.
Usage observability: session/transcript cost analysis, method metrics, obsolescence scans.
Content strategy layer (editorial calendars, hooks, marketing automations) for content/marketing/freelance labs.
Custom-compiled lab generation: brownfield scan -> LAB_BRIEF interview -> machine-enforced clarification gate -> domain agents/skills compiled from justified capabilities.
